packages/logging/src/lonora_logging/__in.name: Logging package
packages/logging/src/lonora_logging/__in.description: Marks the logging code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/logging/src/lonora_logging/cont.name: Log context
packages/logging/src/lonora_logging/cont.description: Remembers the current request and run so logs can be tied to them.

packages/logging/src/lonora_logging/corr.name: Run correlation
packages/logging/src/lonora_logging/corr.description: Tags the logs of a run with its id.

packages/logging/src/lonora_logging/logg.name: Logging setup
packages/logging/src/lonora_logging/logg.description: Sets up logging as JSON with secrets removed.

packages/logging/src/lonora_logging/reda.name: Log redaction
packages/logging/src/lonora_logging/reda.description: Removes secrets from a log record before it is written.

packages/logging/src/lonora_logging/seri.name: Error code
packages/logging/src/lonora_logging/seri.description: Gives an error its stable code for the log.

packages/logging/src/lonora_logging/sink.name: JSON log format
packages/logging/src/lonora_logging/sink.description: Writes each log line as JSON with secrets removed and the request and run ids.
